init.description: Initialize the customer workspace and inspect connection readiness.
init.instructions: Configure the operator and authorized accounts, create or reuse the clean Aimore structure and pilot settings, and report readiness. Use supplied context and saved settings; ask only for missing actual values. Do not enable/create schedules, send messages, or run live CRM write/send acceptance tests from this command. Return setup, missing-input and next-test links.

add-communication.description: Add a communication for review; the shared queue resumes submitted work.
add-communication.instructions: Manually initiate a communication intake with Mode=Manual provenance. Accept authorized source content, a message or transcript. Prepare matching/data/Notes-persona review and stop before unapproved CRM changes. The operator submits in Notion; run-auto or the native queue observes and validates the current submission, then resumes the exact unfinished owner step without a continue command. Existing legacy continuation syntax may still be understood for compatibility, but never require or recommend it. Preserve source, task/run IDs and Mode; no customer sends from this intake command.

run-auto.description: Discover inputs once; exit idle immediately or process affected ready work.
run-auto.instructions: FIRST use event-discovery.md and local scan.probe over current scoped changes and due indexes, before business inference, owner preflights, CRM/source-content/preview checks or routine Dashboard writes. ScanIdle ends immediately after necessary compact index persistence; ScanDiscoveryRequired retries only missing coverage within budget. New mail/replies, actual form submissions, controls/source changes and due timers are events; unchanged waits are not. Only ScanWorkReady enters the bounded affected queue. Run ONE bounded queue cycle under one-cycle-approved-work. Scan authorized Gmail and available SMS reply/stop sources first, then current Notion task/action submissions, due follow-up records, relevant configured Dropbox source/version changes and due internal reminders/confirmed Calendar work. Discover Automatic tasks plus manually initiated communication tasks with submitted current review/data; keep Mode as provenance, not a second continue gate. Observe forms before acceptance, persist the bound accepted submission, then dispatch only each recorded owner step. Use queue-execution.md to enqueue newly ready successors in this same cycle, without recursively restarting scanners or sleeping until future due times. Exact content/preview/version approval remains required for emails and CRM fact changes. Factual SMS notifications use current standing notification-sms-v1 authority: generate/edit, freeze and send when due without per-message ContentReview/SendApproval or a second chat question. Keep stop/pause, invocation no-send restrictions, time/count/channel/attempt checks. Do not create/enable schedules, guess sources, send commercial offers as notifications or replay unknown provider effects. Return actual outcomes, original links, waiting/future/blocked counts and partial coverage. No scheduler management tools or create/list/read capability discovery is required for this deliberate one-cycle command.

report.description: Update and show the current daily action report with original task links.
report.instructions: Upsert the daily brief for the configured business timezone and show pending review/approval/follow-up/submitted-intake tasks, important-reminder state and actual failures with original links. Treat this as a report invocation, not a scheduled reminder run: do not send notifications or customer messages, create/change Calendar events, resume tasks, write CRM business data or run handover rehearsals. Read existing records and write only the report and required operational logs. Missing optional sources remain visible as incomplete coverage, not invented success. Freeze actual report/run/log target IDs at entry and preflight every mutation under notion-publishing.md. Quality recovery cannot edit tasks/actions/hub/previews/Health or call their owners from report. Describe outside-scope findings with a separate next owner command; audit actual writes at exit. Before Completed/final Success, typed saved-page checks and current completion-gate evidence are required; do not accept skipped entities, failed exits or stale evidence.

reply-draft.description: Prepare a source-backed sales reply and matching Notion preview for approval.
reply-draft.instructions: Use supplied authorized inquiry/message/task or registered action-page context and configured Dropbox sources. New inquiry-reply tasks use Mode=Automatic; this command remains draft-only. Prepare/edit copy, source/version evidence, stored draft and matching preview; validate content decisions only and create the separate SendApproval, then stop without sending. A registered current action URL is sufficient context; no continue subcommand is required. Preserve legacy Manual tasks as Manual rather than enrolling them. After content/send submission, point eligible queue work to the next verified native tick or the public run-auto command; never print a private owner command. Do not consume send approval, send, or start SMS from draft-only. Missing facts/identity/preview remain pending.

start.description: Create/reuse one local30-minute approved-work task;20 minutes optional.
start.instructions: Operation=start. Use a verified host-owned local task: codex-local-task for GPT, cowork-local-task with actual local-folder execution for Claude. Require execution_location=local and bind the operator-selected computer and absolute working_directory. Discover automation_update first when exposed. Missing local scheduling/access remains unconfigured, never a cloud fallback. Verify actual native scheduler capabilities, this installation/executor and existing tasks including paused tasks. Reuse/update one owned task or create only after verified absence and prior-attempt reconciliation. Bind the packaged approved-work prompt to actual root/operator/mailbox/runtime/generation; select context.interval_minutes from the explicit optional interval_minutes=20 or interval_minutes=30 argument or saved scheduling.target_scan_minutes (fresh default 30), restrict choices to 20/30, and verify that exact native cadence, full prompt, task ID local execution mode, host/directory, Skill/connector access and enabled state before Running. Enable approved_work_enabled only after verified explicit start; package/init upgrade never broadens old no-send jobs. No immediate scan, customer send, CRM/Calendar write, business-task continuation, silent cadence fallback or independent backend. The computer/app/local runner must remain available. After interruption run one current discovery from saved progress, not every missed tick. Missing native support remains unconfigured. Management availability applies only to this explicit start action. Do not treat its absence as proof that an already-created verified local task cannot execute or mark that task unconfigured; existing ticks follow schedule-execution.md without management-tool discovery.

stop.description: Delete only this installation's owned local task.
stop.instructions: Operation=stop. Read actual saved ownership and native tasks. Persist StopRequested, delete only exact proven installation-owned task IDs and verify complete absence including paused tasks before recording Stopped. Repeat with verified absence is a no-op. A pause, local flag, failed/unknown delete or missing API is not deletion. Preserve business tasks, approvals, provider attempts, history and unrelated schedules. Do not run a scan or send messages. Running scans exit at their next lifecycle check; accepted provider effects are not undone. Owned legacy cloud schedules may be deleted only through their original runtime for migration; never relabel them local, drop unknown IDs or create a second executor. A missing management tool is a deletion limitation only, not a request to run setup from each tick. StopRequested and approved_work_enabled=false still block the existing task while deletion is unresolved.
